title: Candidate Usefulness Trial Spec
description: A supplied observation of meaning, one real use, retained value, and total overhead. This spec does not authenticate observations, resolve references, prove benefit, or grant admission. Human disposition records a preference only. The caller resolves reference existence, exact versions, rights, and staleness.
$comment: Companion usefulness.js additionally rejects numeric sums that overflow finite JavaScript numbers. Format-aware validation is required for calendar-valid date-time values. Recommendation and candidate/propose authority are derived by the evaluator, never accepted from this input. A delta is derived only after meaning, performed real use, evidence, retained value, comparability, error counts, and observed costs are all complete; otherwise it remains null even when numeric totals can be displayed.

reason.description: An empty reason is valid incomplete input, never complete evidence.

human_disposition.description: Recorded preference only; never permission to execute or promote.

minutes.description: Minutes, including zero when actually known. An unknown value must remain null. Never infer missing costs as zero.

references.description: Exact version pins using the containing candidate workspace's existing grammar. Empty arrays preserve incomplete input. Syntactic validity does not establish that a target exists, is usable, or remains current.
